examples: He began a petition in behalf of the farmers.

words.general_translation_vi: Được yêu mến, được yêu quý

examples: in memory of our dearly beloved son, John

meanings: a long seat for two or more people, usually made of wood.
examples: a park bench

meanings: in or to a lower position than somebody/something; under somebody/something.
examples: They found the body buried beneath a pile of leaves.

meanings: improving a situation; having a helpful or useful effect.
examples: A good diet is beneficial to health.

words.general_translation_vi: Người hưởng lợi, người thụ hưởng, người thụ ích,

examples: He sat beside her all night.

words.general_translation_vi: Ngoài ra, hơn nữa, vả lại, vả chăng

examples: I don't really want to go. Besides, it's too late now.

words.general_translation_vi: Bội phản đem nộp cho, bội phản đem giao cho

examples: betray somebody/something, He was offered money to betray his colleagues.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự đặt giá, sự trả giá (trong một cuộc bán đấu giá)

examples: Boswell’s biography of Johnson

meanings: connected with the science of biology.
examples: the biological sciences

meanings: a senior priest in charge of the work of the Church in a city or district.
examples: the Bishop of Oxford

words.general_translation_vi: Kỳ quái, kỳ lạ, kỳ dị
meanings: very strange or unusual.
examples: a bizarre situation/incident/story

meanings: the flat part of a knife, tool or machine, which has a sharp edge or edges for cutting.
examples: The machine comes with a plastic guard over the blade to protect the operator.

meanings: a large cover, often made of wool, used especially on beds to keep people warm.
examples: It’s cold tonight—can I have another blanket?

meanings: an explosion or a powerful movement of air caused by an explosion.

meanings: a mixture of different types of the same thing.
examples: a blend of tea

examples: to pray for God’s blessing

examples: I don't want to boast, but I can actually speak six languages.

words.general_translation_vi: Dũng cảm, táo bạo, cả gan
meanings: brave and confident; not afraid to say what you feel or to take risks.
examples: It was a bold move on their part to open a business in France.

meanings: an occasion when a bomb is dropped or left somewhere; the act of doing this.
examples: recent bombings in major cities

meanings: an extra amount of money that is added to a payment, especially to somebody’s wages or salary as a reward.
examples: a £100 Christmas bonus

words.general_translation_vi: Dạng phân từ hiện tại và danh động từ (gerund) của book
meanings: an arrangement that you make in advance to buy a ticket to travel somewhere, go to the theatre, etc.
examples: a booking form/hall/clerk

meanings: a sudden increase in trade and economic activity; a period of wealth and success.
examples: Living standards improved rapidly during the post-war boom.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự quảng cáo rùm beng (cho ai)
meanings: something that helps or encourages somebody/something.
examples: a great/tremendous/welcome boost

words.general_translation_vi: Sự nảy lên, sự bật lên
meanings: if something bounces or you bounce it, it moves quickly away from a surface it has just hit or you make it do this.
examples: The ball bounced twice before he could reach it.

meanings: a real or imagined line that marks the limits or edges of something and separates it from other things or places; a dividing line.
examples: After the war the national boundaries were redrawn.

meanings: the act of bending your head or the upper part of your body forward in order to say hello or goodbye to somebody or to show respect.
examples: She gave a slight bow of her head in greeting.

words.general_translation_vi: Lỗ đạn, lỗ thủng (ở tường, thành lũy...)
meanings: a failure to do something that must be done by law.
examples: a breach of contract/copyright/warranty

words.general_translation_vi: Sự hỏng máy (ô tô, xe lửa)
meanings: an occasion when a vehicle or machine stops working.
examples: a breakdown on the motorway

meanings: an important development that may lead to an agreement or achievement.
examples: to make/achieve a breakthrough

meanings: a particular type of animal that has been developed by people in a certain way, especially a type of dog, cat or farm animal.
examples: Labradors and other large breeds of dog

meanings: baked clay used for building walls, houses and other buildings; an individual block of this.
examples: The school is built of brick.

meanings: for a short time.
examples: He had spoken to Emma only briefly.

meanings: a way of connecting to the internet that allows you to receive information, including pictures, etc., very quickly and that is always active (so that the user does not have to connect each time).
examples: plans to provide rural areas with fast broadband

words.general_translation_vi: Người nói chuyện trên đài phát thanh, người hát trên đài phát thanh
meanings: a person whose job is presenting or talking on television or radio programmes.
examples: She is a writer and broadcaster on environmental matters.

meanings: generally, without considering details.
examples: Broadly speaking, I agree with you.

words.general_translation_vi: Người kiểm tra hàng hóa để bán nhưng không mua gì
meanings: a computer program that lets you look at or read documents on the World Wide Web.
examples: What do you use as your default browser?

meanings: violent and cruel.
examples: a brutal attack/murder/rape/killing

words.general_translation_vi: Hươu đực, hoẵng đực, nai đực
meanings: a US, Australian or New Zealand dollar; a South African rand; an Indian rupee.
examples: They cost ten bucks.

meanings: a friend.
examples: an old college buddy of mine

meanings: a thing or person that reduces a shock or protects somebody/something against difficulties.
examples: buffer against something, Support from family and friends acts as a buffer against stress.

meanings: any small insect.
examples: There's a bug crawling up your arm.

meanings: the main part of something; most of something.
examples: The bulk of the population lives in cities.

meanings: a duty, responsibility, etc. that causes worry, difficulty or hard work.
examples: to bear/carry/ease/reduce/share the burden

meanings: the system of official rules and ways of doing things that a government or an organization has, especially when these seem to be too complicated.
examples: unnecessary/excessive bureaucracy

words.general_translation_vi: Việc chôn cất, việc mai táng
meanings: the act or ceremony of burying a dead body.
examples: a burial place/mound/site

words.general_translation_vi: Sự nổ tung, sự vỡ tung
meanings: to break open or apart, especially because of pressure from inside; to make something break in this way.
examples: That balloon will burst if you blow it up any more.

words.general_translation_vi: Cabin, buồng ngủ (ở tàu thuỷ, máy bay)
meanings: a small room on a ship in which you live or sleep.
examples: I lay in my cabin feeling miserably seasick.

words.general_translation_vi: Tủ (có nhiều ngăn, đựng đồ dạc quý)
meanings: a group of senior members of a government that is responsible for advising and deciding on government policy.
examples: a cabinet meeting

meanings: the act or process of using numbers to find out an amount.
examples: Cathy did a rough calculation.

meanings: a long straight passage dug in the ground and filled with water for boats and ships to travel along; a smaller passage used for carrying water to fields, crops, etc.
examples: the Panama/Suez Canal

meanings: a round stick of wax with a piece of string (called a wick) through the middle that is lit to give light as it burns.
examples: a flickering candle

meanings: a strong heavy rough material used for making tents, sails, etc. and by artists for painting on.
examples: tents made from heavy canvas

meanings: the ability or qualities necessary to do something.
examples: Age affects the range of a person's capabilities.

meanings: an economic system in which a country’s businesses and industry are controlled and run for profit by private owners rather than by the government.
examples: the growth of industrial capitalism in the West

meanings: based on the principles of capitalism.
examples: a capitalist society/system/economy

meanings: a chemical element. Carbon is found in all living things, existing in a pure state as diamond and graphite.
examples: carbon fibre

meanings: the goods carried in a ship, an aircraft or a motor vehicle.
examples: The tanker began to spill its cargo of oil.

meanings: a separate section of a train for carrying passengers.
examples: a railway carriage

meanings: to make objects, patterns, etc. by cutting away material from a piece of wood or stone, or another hard material.
examples: carve something, a carved doorway

meanings: a public building or room where people play gambling games for money.
examples: a new hotel and casino in Las Vegas

words.general_translation_vi: Tình cờ, bất chợt, ngẫu nhiên, vô tình, không có chủ định
meanings: not formal.
examples: casual clothes (= comfortable clothes that you choose to wear in your free time)

meanings: a person who is killed or injured in war or in an accident.
examples: Our primary objective is reducing road casualties.

meanings: a complete list of items, for example of things that people can look at or buy.
examples: a mail-order catalogue (= a book showing goods for sale to be sent to people’s homes)

words.general_translation_vi: Cung cấp thực phẩm, lương thực
meanings: to provide food and drinks for a social event.
examples: (British English), cater for somebody/something, Most of our work now involves catering for weddings.

meanings: cows and bulls that are kept as farm animals for their milk or meat.
examples: a herd of cattle

words.general_translation_vi: Sự thận trọng, sự cẩn thận
meanings: care that you take in order to avoid danger or mistakes; the fact of not taking any risks.
examples: extreme/great caution

meanings: being careful about what you say or do, especially to avoid danger or mistakes; not taking any risks.
examples: The government has been cautious in its response to the report.

meanings: a large hole in the side of a hill or cliff or under the ground.
examples: the mouth (= the entrance) of the cave

words.general_translation_vi: Dừng, ngừng, ngớt, thôi, hết, tạnh
meanings: to stop happening or existing; to stop something from happening or existing.
examples: Welfare payments cease as soon as an individual starts a job.

meanings: an area of land used for burying dead people, especially one that is not next to a church.
examples: He was buried in a private cemetery.

meanings: the state of being certain.
examples: There is no certainty that the president's removal would end the civil war.

meanings: an official document that may be used to prove that the facts it states are true.
examples: a birth/marriage/death certificate

words.general_translation_vi: Dạng phân từ hiện tại và danh động từ (gerund) của challenge
meanings: difficult in an interesting way that tests your ability.
examples: challenging work/questions/problems

meanings: a hall in a public building that is used for formal meetings.
examples: The members left the council chamber.

meanings: a competition to find the best player or team in a particular sport.
examples: the National Basketball Association Championship

words.general_translation_vi: Thời đại hỗn nguyên, thời đại hỗn mang
meanings: a complete lack of order.
examples: economic/political/domestic chaos

words.general_translation_vi: Biểu thị đặc điểm, mô tả đặc điểm
meanings: to be typical of a person, place or thing.
examples: the rolling hills that characterize this part of England

meanings: the power of pleasing or attracting people.
examples: He was a man of great charm.

words.general_translation_vi: Dạng phân từ hiện tại và danh động từ (gerund) của charm
meanings: very pleasant or attractive.
examples: The cottage is tiny, but it's charming.

meanings: a written statement describing the rights that a particular group of people should have.
examples: the European Social Charter of workers’ rights

words.general_translation_vi: Sự theo đuổi, sự đuổi theo, sự săn đuổi
meanings: an act of running or driving after somebody/something in order to catch them or it.
examples: The thieves were caught by police after a short chase.

meanings: either side of the face below the eyes.
examples: chubby/rosy/pink cheeks

words.general_translation_vi: Sự vui vẻ, sự khoái trá
meanings: a shout of joy, support or praise.
examples: A great cheer went up from the crowd.

words.general_translation_vi: Đội hợp xướng, đội hợp ca (của nhà thờ)
meanings: a group of people who sing together, for example in church services or public performances.
examples: She sings in the school choir.

examples: chop something, He was chopping logs for firewood.

examples: chronic bronchitis/arthritis/asthma

examples: They were granted full French citizenship.

examples: civic buildings/leaders

examples: He left the army and returned to civilian life.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự làm cho văn minh, sự khai hoá

examples: the technology of modern civilization

meanings: to make something clearer or easier to understand.
examples: clarify something, to clarify a situation/problem/issue

meanings: the quality of being expressed clearly.
examples: a lack of clarity in the law

words.general_translation_vi: Tiếng chan chát, tiếng loảng xoảng

examples: Clashes broke out between police and demonstrators.

meanings: to arrange something in groups according to features that they have in common.
examples: The books in the library are classified according to subject.

meanings: a person whose job is to serve customers in a shop.
examples: The clerk at the counter gave me too little change.

meanings: a high area of rock with a very steep side, often at the edge of the sea or ocean.
examples: the cliff edge/top

words.general_translation_vi: Bám vào, dính sát vào, níu lấy
meanings: to hold on tightly to somebody/something.
examples: cling to somebody/something, survivors clinging to a raft

examples: Your local family planning clinic can give you advice about birth control.

words.general_translation_vi: Buồng bệnh, ở buồng bệnh, (thuộc) lâm sàng
meanings: relating to the examination and treatment of patients and their illnesses.
examples: clinical research (= done on patients, not just considering theory)

words.general_translation_vi: Cái ghim, cái cặp, cái kẹp

examples: Here is a clip from her latest movie.

examples: factory closures

examples: The telescope is focused on a dense cluster of stars at the edge of the galaxy.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự liên kết, sự liên hiệp, sự liên minh

examples: The two parties have formed a coalition.

examples: coastal waters/resorts/scenery

examples: a cocktail bar/cabinet/lounge/shaker

meanings: connected with mental processes of understanding.
examples: a child’s cognitive development

words.general_translation_vi: Trùng khớp với nhau (hai vật cùng đường diện tích, cùng đường chu vi như nhau)

examples: It's a pity our trips to New York don't coincide.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự trùng khớp, sự trùng nhau

examples: a strange/an extraordinary/a remarkable coincidence

examples: Researchers around the world are collaborating to develop a new vaccine.

meanings: the act of working with another person or group of people to create or produce something.
examples: It was a collaboration that produced extremely useful results.

meanings: done or shared by all members of a group of people; involving a whole group or society.
examples: collective leadership/decision-making/responsibility

words.general_translation_vi: Người thu thập, người sưu tầm
meanings: a person who collects things, either as a hobby or as a job.
examples: a stamp collector

meanings: an accident in which two vehicles or people crash into each other.
examples: collision between A and B, a collision between two trains

meanings: connected with or belonging to a country that controls another country.
examples: a colonial power

meanings: a country or an area that is governed by people from another, more powerful, country.
examples: former British colonies

meanings: full of bright colours or having a lot of different colours.
examples: colourful shop windows

words.general_translation_vi: Người chuyên giữ một mục báo

examples: a newspaper columnist

words.general_translation_vi: Trận, trận đấu, trận đánh, trận chiến đấu

examples: in combat, He was killed in combat.

meanings: humorous and making you laugh.
examples: a comic monologue/story

words.general_translation_vi: Người điều khiển, người cầm đầu người chỉ huy, sĩ quan chỉ huy
meanings: a person who is in charge of something, especially an officer in charge of a particular group of soldiers or a military operation.
examples: military/allied/field/flight commanders

words.general_translation_vi: Bắt đầu, mở đầu, khởi đầu
meanings: to begin to happen; to begin something.
examples: The meeting is scheduled to commence at noon.

examples: a sports commentary

meanings: a person who describes an event while it is happening, especially on television or radio.
examples: a television/sports commentator

meanings: trade, especially between countries; the buying and selling of goods and services.
examples: Leaders of industry and commerce met at the summit in Paris.

meanings: a member of a commission (= an official group of people who are responsible for controlling something or finding out about something).
examples: the Church Commissioners (= the group of people responsible for controlling the financial affairs of the Church of England)

meanings: a product or a raw material that can be bought and sold.
examples: rice, flour and other basic commodities

meanings: connected with communism.
examples: communist ideology

meanings: a person or an animal that travels with you or spends a lot of time with you.
examples: travelling companions

meanings: similar to somebody/something else and able to be compared.
examples: A comparable house in the south of the city would cost twice as much.

meanings: measured or judged by how similar or different it is to something else.
examples: Then he was living in comparative comfort (= compared with others or with his own life at a previous time).

words.general_translation_vi: Tình thương, sự thương yêu, lòng trắc ẩn
meanings: a strong feeling of sympathy for people or animals who are suffering and a desire to help them.
examples: to feel/show compassion

words.general_translation_vi: Buộc phải, bắt phải, bắt buộc, ép, thúc ép
meanings: to force somebody to do something; to make something necessary.
examples: compel somebody to do something, The law can compel fathers to make regular payments for their children.

words.general_translation_vi: Dạng phân từ hiện tại và danh động từ (gerund) của compel
meanings: that makes you pay attention to it because it is so interesting and exciting.
examples: Her latest book makes compelling reading.

meanings: to provide something good to balance or reduce the bad effects of damage, loss, etc.
examples: Nothing can compensate for the loss of a loved one.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự đền bù, sự bồi thường (thiệt hại)
meanings: something, especially money, that somebody gives you because they have hurt you, or damaged something that you own; the act of giving this to somebody.
examples: to claim/award/receive compensation

examples: to gain a high level of competence in English

words.general_translation_vi: Có đủ khả năng, có đủ trình độ, thạo giỏi
meanings: having enough skill or knowledge to do something well or to the necessary standard.
examples: He's very competent in his work.

words.general_translation_vi: Biên soạn, sưu tập tài liệu
meanings: to produce a book, list, report, etc. by bringing together different items, articles, songs, etc.; to collect information in order to produce a book, list, etc.
examples: We are trying to compile a list of suitable people for the job.

meanings: to add to something in a way that improves it or makes it more attractive.
examples: The excellent menu is complemented by a good wine list.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự hoàn thành, sự làm xong
meanings: the act or process of finishing something; the state of being finished and complete.
examples: the completion of the new hospital building

meanings: the state of being formed of many parts; the state of being difficult to understand.
examples: the increasing complexity of modern telecommunication systems

words.general_translation_vi: Sự bằng lòng, sự ưng thuận, sự chiều theo, sự làm đúng theo (một yêu cầu, một lệnh... )
meanings: the practice of obeying rules or requests made by people in authority.
examples: compliance (with something), procedures that must be followed to ensure full compliance with the law

words.general_translation_vi: Sự phức tạp, sự rắc rối
meanings: a thing that makes a situation more complicated or difficult.
examples: The bad weather added a further complication to our journey.

meanings: to obey a rule, an order, etc.; to meet particular standards.
examples: They refused to comply with the UN resolution.

meanings: to write music.
examples: Mozart composed his last opera shortly before he died.

meanings: a person who writes music, especially classical music.
examples: Verdi was a prolific composer of operas.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự hợp thành, sự cấu thành
meanings: the different parts that something is made of; the way in which the different parts are organized.
examples: the chemical composition of the soil

meanings: a thing consisting of two or more separate things combined together.
examples: compounds derived from rainforest plants

words.general_translation_vi: Có đầy đủ thông tin một cách toàn diện
meanings: including all, or almost all, the items, details, facts, information, etc., that may be involved.
examples: a comprehensive list of addresses

meanings: to have somebody/something as parts or members.
examples: comprise something, The collection comprises 327 paintings.

examples: After lengthy talks the two sides finally reached a compromise.

words.general_translation_vi: Ép buộc, bắt buộc, cưỡng bách
meanings: that must be done because of a law or a rule.
examples: English is a compulsory subject at this level.

examples: The losses were computed at £5 million.

meanings: to hide somebody/something.
examples: conceal somebody/something, The paintings were concealed beneath a thick layer of plaster.

meanings: to admit that something is true, logical, etc. after first denying it or resisting it.
examples: + speech, ‘Not bad,’ she conceded grudgingly.

words.general_translation_vi: Nghĩ, hiểu, quan điểm được, nhận thức
meanings: to form an idea, a plan, etc. in your mind.
examples: He conceived the idea of transforming the old power station into an arts centre.

meanings: an understanding or a belief of what something/somebody is or what something/somebody should be.
examples: conception of something, Marx’s conception of social justice

meanings: something that you allow or do, or allow somebody to have, in order to end an argument or to make a situation less difficult.
examples: The firm will be forced to make concessions if it wants to avoid a strike.

meanings: made of concrete.
examples: a concrete floor

words.general_translation_vi: Kết án, kết tội, xử, xử phạt
meanings: to say very strongly that you think something is bad, usually for moral reasons.
examples: condemn somebody/something, The government issued a statement condemning the killings.

meanings: to discuss something with somebody, in order to exchange opinions or get advice.
examples: He wanted to confer with his colleagues before reaching a decision.

examples: After hours of questioning, the suspect confessed.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự thú tội, sự thú nhận
meanings: a statement that a person makes, admitting that they are guilty of a crime; the act of making such a statement.
examples: After hours of questioning by police, she made a full confession.

meanings: an arrangement of the parts of something or a group of things; the form or shape that this arrangement produces.
examples: configuration of something, The design is based on four configurations of squares.

words.general_translation_vi: Giam giữ, giam hãm, giam cầm, nhốt giữ lại
meanings: to keep somebody/something inside the limits of a particular activity, subject, area, etc.
examples: be confined to (doing) something, The work will not be confined to the Glasgow area.

examples: an increase in the prevalence of smoking among young people

words.general_translation_vi: Sự ngăn cản, sự ngăn trở, sự ngăn ngừa, sự phòng ngừa

words.general_translation_vi: Có thể có, có khả năng xảy ra, chắc hẳn, có lễ đúng, có lẽ thật

words.general_translation_vi: Có vấn đề gì đó còn tồn đọng

words.general_translation_vi: Dạng phân từ hiện tại và danh động từ (gerund) của proceed

words.general_translation_vi: Động từ chia ở ngôi thứ ba số ít của proceed

words.general_translation_vi: Máy chế biến, máy xử lý

words.general_translation_vi: Sự phóng ra, sự bắn ra

words.general_translation_vi: Đầy hứa hẹn, đầy triển vọng

words.general_translation_vi: Sự thăng chức, sự thăng cấp, sự đề bạt

words.general_translation_vi: Quá khứ và phân từ quá khứ của pronounce

words.general_translation_vi: Sự cân xứng, sự cân đối

words.general_translation_vi: Lời đề nghị, kế hoạch, đề xuất, dự kiến đề ra

words.general_translation_vi: Bảo vệ, bảo hộ, che chở

examples: housing provision

words.general_translation_vi: Dạng phân từ hiện tại và danh động từ (gerund) của publish

examples: (British English), a petrol pump

words.general_translation_vi: Cú đấm, cú thoi, cú thụi

examples: a punk band

examples: I saw the letter purely by chance.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự đuổi theo, sự đuổi bắt, sự truy nã, sự truy kích

words.general_translation_vi: Riêng từng người, riêng từng cái
